question: Give the complete ordered method for ordinary Cedar cache restarts.
answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

This complete procedure applies to ordinary Cedar cache restarts. 1. Verify the maintenance ticket before starting the Cedar cache restart. 2. Stop the staging cache process and record the service state. 3. Start the staging cache process and check the health endpoint. 4. Record the health result and close the maintenance ticket. Do not restart the production cache. [1]
